user_goal: Remove cumulative release privacy leaks, finish accessibility, and resolve verified PR review state before release.

authority.verbatim_text: Correct every verified review blocker before merging and releasing Plotkeeper v0.1.7.

baseline.protected_ref: reviewed PR candidate before final remediation
baseline.protection_evidence: Exact clean pushed PR head independently reviewed
baseline.selection_reason: The independent reviewer found three bounded release blockers on this exact candidate.

resources: GitHub PR 1 review-thread resolution and exact-head checks
semantic_changes: Sanitize only the six newly added cumulative contracts, add the missing picker accessible name, resolve only the already-fixed installer review thread, and re-run review.
No unrelated code, merge, release, install, service restart, secret exposure, or historical behavior change.

invariants: All prior behavior and proof remain intact.
No local session ID, account path, or raw user text remains in the cumulative v0.1.7 contract diff.
PR remains unmerged until fresh independent PASS.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The cumulative candidate is privacy-clean, accessible, review-resolved, and independently approved.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Residual identifier leak, inaccessible picker, unresolved actionable thread, or unreviewed release.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: Plotkeeper v0.1.7 PR candidate and release reviewer

proof_requirements.claim: Leak scan, accessibility regression, GitHub thread state, full tests, CI, and independent review prove remediation.
proof_requirements.required_environment: clean exact PR head and GitHub
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: cumulative scan, tests, PR metadata, production-goal-review
proof_requirements.expected_observation: zero leaks, zero unresolved actionable threads, all checks and phase receipts PASS

release_requirements.required_receipt: signed phase chain accepted by verifier and trusted guard

stop_conditions: Unexpected diff, residual leak, unresolved review, failed test/CI, or non-PASS review receipt.
known_discrepancies: CodeRabbit rate-limited the latest incremental request after reviewing the substantive corrections; exact-head CI remains required.
